styles.title: 2.5D
styles.motion: 카메라가 옆으로 이동할 때 가까운 나뭇잎은 빠르게, 트램은 중간 속도로, 먼 건물은 느리게 움직입니다. 레이어마다 이동량을 달리해 한 장의 이미지에 공간감을 만듭니다.
styles.rhythm: 느린 카메라 이동 · 레이어별 속도 차이
styles.usage: 여행 필름 · 다큐멘터리 인트로 · 사진 시퀀스
styles.direction: An original cinematic sunlit European tram-street scene intended for a 2.5D parallax animation. Distinct depth planes: dark leaves and two empty cafe chairs close to camera, an ochre-orange tram moving horizontally in the middle plane with restrained directional motion blur, and pale historic architecture beneath a blue sky far behind. Elegant late-afternoon lighting, tactile photographic realism and clear foreground occlusion. Slightly separated photo-cutout depth at a few plane edges makes the layered technique legible without diagram arrows. Balanced film composition, beautiful restrained colors. No text anywhere.

styles.title: COLLAGE
styles.description: 사진 조각과 종이, 글자를 리듬 있게 조합
styles.motion: 오려낸 인물과 종이 조각이 서로 다른 박자로 들어오고, 글자가 한 음절씩 튀어 오릅니다. 회전과 짧은 멈춤을 섞어 손으로 한 장씩 붙이는 듯한 리듬을 만듭니다.
styles.rhythm: 짧은 등장 · 불규칙한 회전 · 스톱모션 리듬
styles.direction: An original vibrant mixed-media collage animation styleframe. A black-and-white cutout photograph of an adult jumping in the air interacts with oversized cut-paper letters spelling exactly 'PLAY'. Torn off-white graph paper backdrop, saturated violet letters, thick sky-blue tape strokes, one orange paper sun and a rough charcoal rectangular strip. Distinct torn edges, offset registration, scanned paper textures and sparse hand-drawn swooshes. Show one compelling captured moment as the pieces spring into place, with deliberate uneven rotation and energetic scale shifts. Strong editorial composition. The only large readable word is 'PLAY'. No copied image, no UI.

styles.title: KINETIC TYPE
styles.motion: ‘MOVE’가 화면 밖에서 들어와 압축되었다가 넓게 펼쳐집니다. 글자별 도착 시점을 조금씩 어긋나게 하고, 강한 비트에서 잠깐 멈춰 읽히는 순간을 확보합니다.
styles.rhythm: 빠른 진입 · 탄성 변형 · 짧은 정지
styles.usage: 타이틀 시퀀스 · 행사 티저 · 메시지 중심 광고
styles.direction: An original sophisticated kinetic typography animation styleframe. Pure black background with gigantic white grotesk letters spelling exactly 'MOVE' as the central dominant word. The letters are captured at staggered moments of elastic stretch, squash and horizontal movement, but the word remains immediately readable. Repeated thin white contour echoes and a second tightly cropped large typographic row imply successive motion positions. One restrained acid-yellow block accent punctuates the rhythm. Extreme typographic scale, sharp graphic precision, purposeful cropping, asymmetric negative space. Typography itself is the entire image; no objects, decorative pictograms, screenshot frame or UI. No extra words.

styles.title: SAAS
styles.motion: 작은 구체가 곡선을 따라 이동하면 질문 카드가 나타나고, 이어서 응답 카드가 펼쳐집니다. 시선이 입력에서 결과로 자연스럽게 이어지도록 연결선과 카드의 등장 시점을 맞춥니다.
styles.usage: 제품 소개 영상 · 기능 출시 · 온보딩
styles.direction: An original premium SaaS product-motion styleframe in a luminous white studio-like graphic space. A small beautiful polished chrome orb follows a very fine curved orbit line between two isolated translucent-white product message cards; the first card contains the short exact label 'Ask', the second contains 'Create' with a tiny check mark. Cards are floating at carefully staggered depths with delicate realistic shadows, subtle perspective and minimalist black typography. A tiny restrained periwinkle light accent, abundant white space, a clear visual transition from input to completed output. This is a cinematic motion-graphics composition using a few UI fragments, not a complete webpage, dashboard or device mockup. No logo, no screenshot framing, no other wording.

styles.title: EXPLAINER
styles.motion: 건물이 차례로 올라오고, 나무와 인물이 등장한 뒤 자전거가 경로를 따라 이동합니다. 한 번에 한 요소씩 강조해 시청자가 이야기의 원인과 결과를 따라가게 합니다.
styles.usage: 서비스 설명 · 교육 영상 · 공공 캠페인
styles.direction: An original polished flat-illustration explainer-animation styleframe. A friendly geometric city streetscape under a clear pale-cyan sky: an elegant tall coral building with a grid of blue windows near the center, a shorter cobalt building to the left, muted green architecture on the right, tidy small trees and one simplified courier on a bicycle moving along a clear curved warm-yellow route. Clean vector-like flat shapes rendered as raster art, consistent confident proportions, restrained use of shading, logical layered scene construction and strong visual hierarchy. A clear readable storytelling scene with enough empty sky for motion staging. No text, no infographic labels, no screen border, no photo textures.
